info.title: Podry V1 API Design
info.description: All 79 HTTP operations implemented. GitHub, Gitea, GitLab and Gitee Push Webhook providers share persistent build admission. Database v18 expands the delivery provider constraint without adding tables; non-GitHub history prevents downgrade. Built-in Chart 1.1.0 preserves Chart 1.0.0 and historical snapshots. Build, release, resource write and health polling workers default disabled. Provider protocol/isolated integration tests are separate from real provider delivery and CI/CD acceptance. See docs/backend/38-git-webhook-providers.md and docs/backend/29-live-cicd-acceptance.md.

post.description: Creates a fresh git/image application. Optional cloneFromAppId atomically copies the latest source configuration after source read, destination configure and credential-reference scope checks; sourceMode must match. Saved config becomes version 1; an unsaved source stays virtual version 0. Build imageRepository becomes podry/<new app UUID>. Archived sources are allowed; destination is unarchived with unknown health. No pipelines, bindings, artifacts, runtime state, credential plaintext or network execution are copied. Returns 409 for duplicate project/name; this operation has no idempotency replay contract. See docs/backend/19-application-cloning.md.

post.description: Persists cancellation intent without revoking an in-flight lease. Unsubmitted tasks cancel immediately; submitted jobs require controller suspension and owned Pod exit confirmation. Verified completion may win. Unknown outcomes stay unknown. No request body required; an empty object is accepted.

Retries only failed/canceled builds after confirming the old execution has stopped. Keeps the same Build, SHA, config version and exact execution/credential versions, creating a new Attempt, Job and image tag with the current retry actor. Unknown, active and successful builds are rejected. Disabled executor returns 503 without reservations. Same-key replay reauthorizes scope and returns the original 202. No request body required; an empty object is accepted.

post.summary: 解析并导入已有镜像产物
post.description: Explicit Registry read outside database transactions. Resolves and verifies OCI/Docker schema 2 manifest or index sha256 bytes, pins tags by fetching the computed digest, and creates source=external with buildId=null. Requires a full reference matching the selected Registry authority; omitted tag means latest. Same-key replay is offline with current app and frozen credential scope authorization. Rotation or permission changes during network access fail without artifacts or reservations. Does not create a Build or deployment. See docs/backend/18-image-artifacts.md.

Offline built-in Chart rendering from a verified artifact. Freezes config, binding, workflow/CD, chart archive/checksum, credential versions and execution identity. Expires in 10 minutes. Diff compares the last successful platform snapshot, not live Kubernetes resources; warnings make this boundary explicit. Secret targetKey selects the same-named key from the exact credential version and maps it to a container environment variable. No Git, Registry or Kubernetes network access.

post.description: Rechecks actor, target grants, expiry and frozen versions, then creates an immutable snapshot, ReleaseRequest and reserved Deployment atomically. The durable Helm executor is opt-in via PODRY_RELEASE_ENABLED; disabled by default, returning 503 without consuming the preview or creating tasks. Same-key retries return the original accepted result. Workers serialize physical targets, preserve unknown occupancy, and observe frozen Helm execution identity, revision and resource UIDs without replaying ambiguous submissions. Real CI/CD acceptance is deferred.

get.summary: 发布快照与当前资源差异
get.description: Before is the normalized immutable desired manifest; after is the current cluster read of its recorded root identities. Both sides omit server bookkeeping, status, Secret values and Secret annotations. Requires resource.view for every root type. Missing live objects are omitted from after; unrecorded identities or replacement UIDs return 409. Upstream failures are errors, never an empty live manifest. Does not include descendant objects or promise Secret value comparison.

post.description: Creates a new durable request using the successful source artifact and current destination configuration. Requires another binding in the same app. Default-disabled executor returns 503 without tasks or idempotency reservation. Busy or unknown destination returns 409 target_busy. Same-key replay reauthorizes frozen resource permissions even after config/executor changes. See docs/backend/16-release-actions.md.

post.summary: 基于历史快照创建回滚请求
post.description: Creates a new durable request from a successful deployment in the same binding. Preserves historical business values, approved Chart archive, digest and exact Secret versions; generates new identities so Job runs again. Uses current CD authorization and transport credentials. Missing dependencies fail closed. Default-disabled executor returns 503 without tasks; busy/unknown target returns 409. See docs/backend/16-release-actions.md.

post.summary: 只读核对已提交发布的实际结果
post.description: Explicit read-only Helm Observe works independently of background switches. Never submits again or forcibly unlocks unknown. Requires submitting/observing/unknown, matching expectedRevision and no live worker lease. Rechecks actor, membership, target grants, binding, current cluster credentials, root identities and fencing after bounded network reads. Commits outcome, resource identities, success pointer, target release, audit and replay atomically. Ambiguous/missing/conflicting evidence retains unknown and occupancy. Same-key replay reauthorizes but needs no executor, keys or network. See docs/backend/26-release-reconciliation.md.
post.x-permission: deploy.trigger + resource.view/write on frozen roots and Helm Secrets; Job also needs pods view

get.description: Requires a binding belonging to the application. Reads recorded root UIDs on its current physical target, including known resources from failed/inflight executions. Traverses controller OwnerReferences through Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pod and Job -> Pod; labels alone never establish ownership. Intersects each type with current resource grants and filters unreadable objects. Missing objects are omitted; UID replacement returns 409. Secret data and annotations are redacted. Successful reads refresh a 60-second binding health observation; read failures invalidate the observation when its source is unchanged. This read-through endpoint remains available independently of opt-in read-only background polling. The poller refreshes the same cache using the latest release requester with current permissions; no cluster writes occur. See docs/backend/25-background-health.md.

Defaults to local cache/history without decryption or network. Explicit refresh performs read-only UID-bound cluster GETs against the current successful deployment snapshot. Persists counts and status only, never manifests, paths, values or hashes of values. Secret values are excluded. Returns up to 20 observations of the current baseline; retains 100 per binding. Cache expires after 60 seconds or binding/deployment/credential/root/platform resource-operation identity changes. Pending/unknown platform resource operations anywhere in the cluster and a newer unsettled release force unknown. Stable upstream failure or UID replacement records unknown; revoked permissions or concurrent identity changes return 404/409 without recording. Aligned describes projected fields only and does not prove Secret equality, health or convergence. Historical deployment Diff does not update this cache.
get.x-permission: app.view + resource.view for every baseline root

post.summary: 只读核对资源 Apply 或动作结果
post.description: Explicit read-only recovery works with all background execution disabled. Requires running/unknown with a durable unresolved item, matching expectedRevision and no live worker lease. Uses current credentials on the frozen physical cluster; rechecks actor, membership, grants, transport credentials and revision after bounded reads. Never resubmits writes; pending items are skipped. Signed markers and normalized content confirm writes; disappearance of the original UID confirms delete. Incomplete evidence retains unknown. Result, revision, completion, audit and idempotency commit atomically. First and replay bytes match; replay reauthorizes without keys or network. New reads require the encrypted original plan and signing key. See docs/backend/27-resource-reconciliation.md.
post.x-permission: request owner + current resource.view and action permission for every frozen target (delete needs resource.delete; others resource.write)

post.description: Exact core/v1 Secret namespace/name/UID/resourceVersion required. Only requested Base64 values are returned; missing keys reject the whole request. Rechecks current account, membership, grants and credentials after the read, then audits atomically before releasing values. No secret values, key names or free-text reason in audit or idempotency storage. See docs/backend/28-sensitive-resource-access.md.

post.summary: 创建短期 Pod 终端会话
post.description: Exact core/v1 Pod UID and container required; optional initial resourceVersion is checked. Creates a 30-second single-use, same-origin ticket; no command runs until WebSocket connection. Connect via returned path and subprotocols podry.exec.v1, ticket.<ticket>; only podry.exec.v1 is echoed. Current user/grants/credentials/Pod are rechecked on connect and every 5 seconds. Global 16/per-user 2 independent terminal quota; pending sessions count. Login expiry, 10-minute input idle, one-hour maximum, disconnect, DELETE and server drain close and reclaim streams. Process-local sessions do not survive restart. See docs/backend/28-sensitive-resource-access.md.

delete.summary: 关闭当前用户的终端会话
delete.description: Only the authenticated owner can close a pending or active terminal. Audit before cancellation, then reclaim upstream connection. Resource grants are not required for closing; absent/expired/completed/foreign sessions return 404. No command retry.

post.summary: 接收已认证的 Push Webhook
post.description: GitHub/Gitea/GitLab/Gitee; application/json, maximum 1 MiB. Authenticate before strict JSON parsing. GitHub uses X-GitHub-Delivery/Event and raw-body HMAC-SHA256 X-Hub-Signature-256; Gitea uses X-Gitea-Delivery/Event/Signature (hex HMAC, no prefix). GitLab uses X-Gitlab-Event and either X-Gitlab-Token or Standard Webhooks whsec_ signing token with webhook-id/timestamp/signature (5 minute tolerance); no fallback from signature to token. GitLab delivery id preference: webhook-id, Idempotency-Key, X-Gitlab-Event-UUID. Gitee uses X-Gitee-Event/Token/Timestamp (milliseconds, 1 hour tolerance); signature covers timestamp plus secret, NOT body. Gitee token mode requires explicit credential opt-in. TLS is required for integrity of token/Gitee payloads. Gitee deliveryId is sha256:<digest> of event plus canonical JSON excluding top-level password/sign/timestamp, so re-signing replays and identical events coalesce. Other providers hash event plus raw body; same provider/pipeline/delivery with different hash returns 409. Current delegated authorization, credential version and repository/branch are rechecked. Ignore deleted/tag/other-repository/non-push events durably. New accepted builds require enabled build execution; 503 leaves delivery reusable. Freeze full lowercase SHA-1 for runner checkout; no remote Git query. Existing explicit non-production on_ci_success policy can subsequently deploy the successful build. Never persist/log raw payload, tokens or secrets.

autoDeployAllowed.description: Explicit opt-in for non-production environments only. production=true requires false. Only platform administrators can create environment policies.

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: Explicit per-credential TLS verification bypass for a trusted test endpoint.

payload.description: Encrypted AES-256-GCM version. Kubernetes accepts a structured HTTPS endpoint with either Token or inline client certificate/key and optional explicit insecureSkipTLSVerify. No raw YAML, exec, auth-provider or file references. kubeconfig requires teamId=null.
Must match stored credential kind. Retains previous versions. kubeconfig rotation keeps apiServer unchanged.

endpoint.description: HTTPS by default. HTTP requires an exact host:port entry in PODRY_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Anonymous registries use credentialId=null.

namespace.description: Exact Namespace, * for all namespaced targets, or empty string for cluster scope. * never grants cluster scope.

items.description: Discovery group/plural; core resources use core/plural. CRDs accepted, subresources rejected.

health.description: Derived from binding observations refreshed by application resource reads or opt-in background health polling (PODRY_HEALTH_POLLING_ENABLED, default false). The poller uses the latest release requester with current app/resource permissions and durable per-binding leases; normal retries are scheduled after 30 seconds. Unreadable/stale results do not publish health. Expires after 60 seconds; a new execution/revision, binding edit or cluster credential rotation invalidates the observation. Release success alone does not imply healthy. Archived applications report stopped.

cloneFromAppId.description: Optional source application. Atomically copies its latest authorized config into the new app; sourceMode must match. Source app.view and destination app.configure are required. Credential references must be usable in both scopes. Build imageRepository becomes podry/<new app UUID>. No workflows, bindings, artifacts or execution state are copied.

repositoryUrl.description: HTTPS by default. HTTP requires an exact host:port entry in PODRY_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Embedded credentials and redirects are rejected.

resolvedRef.description: 本次查询分支 tip 的完整 SHA；空仓库为空字符串。

chartVersion.description: Built-in immutable Chart version. 1.1.0 adds Ingress className, TLS secret reference and optional cert-manager ClusterIssuer. Existing 1.0.0 snapshots remain supported. Live execution requires the release worker.

DeployValues.description: Current subset: replicaCount, containerPort, resources.requests/limits.cpu/memory, non-sensitive literal env, service.enabled/port/type=ClusterIP, ingress.enabled/host, and Job single-run fields. Chart 1.1.0 additionally permits ingress.className/tlsSecretName/clusterIssuer as DNS subdomain names; empty optional strings omit the setting. A nonempty clusterIssuer requires tlsSecretName and cert-manager installed on the cluster. Enabled Ingress requires an enabled Service and host. Volumes and all unknown/reserved image/ownership fields are rejected. Sensitive values use versioned secretRefs; targetKey must not duplicate literal env. Job rejects Deployment/service/ingress fields.

ConfigInput.description: Save exactly one section, merge other sections from the expected snapshot, then append one config version. Reject fields belonging to another section. First save expects version 0.

deployableBindingIds.description: Local candidates require an enabled release executor/CD, a verified build or external image artifact, valid render inputs, deploy role, target write grants including Helm Secret storage, and usable exact credential/Secret versions. No network probe or release task is performed. Preview and confirmation revalidate the selected inputs and target occupancy.

BindingInput.description: Creates an independent binding only; no CD or execution is implied. Requires saved base configuration, app.configure and write grants for effective resource kinds. autoDeploy=true requires an environment with autoDeployAllowed=true and production=false. Binding opt-in alone does not delegate deployment; save an enabled on_ci_success CD. Environment and physical target are immutable after creation. Overrides merge recursively over base values; null and platform image/identity/Secret fields are rejected.

BindingUpdate.description: Replaces the complete override object and increments binding version. Empty object restores base inheritance. Maps merge recursively over base; scalars replace. Requires write grants for both previous and resulting resource kinds. Queued, active, unknown or occupied targets reject with target_busy. Existing previews become stale. autoDeploy=true requires explicit non-production environment policy. Changing the binding version invalidates older automatic intents; environment and target cannot be changed.

CIDefinition.description: At least one of manual/push must be true. push requires a dedicated kind=secret credential with data.webhookSecret (32-256 bytes) and optional data.webhookAuthMode=signature/token; no other data fields. push=false requires null. Saving delegates Push admission to the saving user, rechecked on every delivery. GitHub, Gitea, GitLab and Gitee Push are implemented. GitHub/Gitea require signature mode; GitLab defaults to Standard Webhooks for whsec_ secrets, otherwise token; Gitee defaults to timestamp signature, token requires explicit opt-in. Automatic CD is a separate explicit delegation to its saving user.

CDDefinition.description: on_ci_success requires the same application CI, an opted-in binding and non-production environment policy. Enabled automatic CD explicitly delegates deploy to the saving user; current deploy, target and credential access is rechecked. Only builds admitted after this delegation capture automatic intents. Configuration/workflow/CI/CD/binding version changes invalidate old intents. Manual preview/confirmation remain available.

definition.description: Must match kind. Production bindings require manual in V1.

WorkflowTemplateInput.description: Atomic template transaction. Null CD upstream in build_deploy is resolved to the newly created CI ID. external_image requires sourceMode=image and creates a binding/CD with null upstream. add_deploy references the existing CI for Git apps or adds another CD to an existing image workflow. No builds/deployments are started by saving a template.

commitSha.description: Full lowercase SHA-1 reachable from the configured CI branch. SHA-256 repositories are not yet supported.

autoDeployments.description: Optional build detail field; omitted when empty and on build list/admission responses. waiting awaits a verified successful artifact, including a later retry of this Build; failed/canceled/unknown builds never dispatch. blocked retries local admission every 30 seconds. dispatched means release queued, not deployed or healthy. skipped is terminal after stale policy or revoked authorization.

imageRef.description: Full reference: registry.example.test/team/demo:tag or registry.example.test/team/demo@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. Authority must match the selected Registry. Omitted tag defaults to latest. No URLs or embedded credentials. Mutable tags are pinned server-side; manifest/index content is verified, not individual blobs.

revision.description: Durable reconciliation revision, independent of Helm revision. Send as expectedRevision for explicit read-only reconciliation.

ReconcileDeploymentInput.description: Requires a submitted, nonterminal deployment and no live worker lease. Trimmed reason must contain 1-1000 characters. The full input participates in the idempotency hash; only reason length enters audit, never free text.

PromoteInput.description: Requires a successful source deployment and another binding of the same app. Reuses the exact verified artifact digest with the current destination configuration and overrides. Requires enabled manual CD and current target/Secret permissions. No Registry network probe is performed.

RollbackInput.description: Reason must contain 1-1000 characters after trimming. Uses the successful source deployment in the same binding, preserving historical business values, exact archived Chart, image digest and Secret versions. New deployment/Job/Secret identities are created. Current CD authorization and cluster transport credentials apply. Reason is stored with the request and omitted from audit payloads.

manifest.description: Formatted JSON manifest (valid YAML 1.2); Secret values and annotations removed.

ManifestDocument.description: One strict YAML/JSON object per entry; namespaced objects require metadata.namespace. Existing objects require both UID and resourceVersion, explicitly or in metadata. Creates use POST; updates use PUT full replacement. Lists and generateName are not accepted.

diff.description: Before/after JSON strings contain removed/added/changed field paths only, never manifest values.

ResourceActionInput.description: Full UID/resourceVersion confirms the target. delete needs view+delete; restart/scale need view+write and apps/v1 Deployment. scale rejects matching HPA or incomplete checks. Namespace conflicts with platform releases return 409. An accepted 202 is not completion.

reason.description: Trimmed nonempty reason; only character count is audited. Included in idempotency fingerprint.

command.description: Exact argv, at most 8 KiB in total; no implicit shell or automatic retry.
